Vendored third-party assets bundled verbatim into generated offline reports.

  library:  mermaid

  source:   npm mermaid@11.4.1 -> package/dist/mermaid.min.js (UMD, self-contained)

  version:  3.0.0  (pinned in pyproject `report` extra)
  license:  MIT
  why:      canonical-markdown -> HTML AST for lossless full-document rendering,
            section anchoring, and mermaid-block location.
